data.one_liner: Easy directory picker and folder creation tool for Flutter on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to pick directories and create new folders within a Flutter application. Handles permission requests required for storage access on Android.
use_when: You need to let users select directories on Android
You need folder creation functionality inside your folder picker
You want a simple folder selection dialog with automatic permission checks
avoid_when: You need cross-platform support for iOS, Web, or Desktop (supports Android only)
You need to pick individual files instead of directories
strengths: Handles runtime storage permissions out of the box
Simple API with a clear dialog usage pattern
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native AndroidManifest permissions and legacy storage flags
data.setup_notes: Requires adding READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions to android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, and handling Android 10/11 storage flags and runtime permissions.
